# Contributing to ComfyUI Workflow Packs

Thank you for your interest in contributing!

## How to Contribute

### Report Issues

- Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Hardonian/comfyui-workflow-packs/issues) for bug reports
- Include your ComfyUI version, GPU model, and checkpoint used
- Attach screenshots of errors if possible

### Suggest Improvements

- Open an issue with the "enhancement" label
- Describe the workflow improvement and use case

### Submit Workflows

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a feature branch: `git checkout -b my-new-workflow`
3. Add your workflow JSON and a README.md
4. Submit a pull request

## Workflow Guidelines

- Test with at least one SDXL checkpoint before submitting
- Include default negative prompts
- Document the workflow purpose and settings in a README.md
- Use consistent node naming
